description: Header file defining C API for AOTInductor runtime, including model container creation, inference, constants management, and model handling functions.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerCreate
methods.description: Creates a model container with specified number of models and CPU flag.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerCreateWithDevice
methods.description: Creates a model container with specified device string.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerDelete
methods.description: Deletes a model container.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerRun
methods.description: Runs inference on the model container.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerRunSingleThreaded
methods.description: Runs inference in a single-threaded manner.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerGetNumConstants
methods.description: Retrieves number of constants.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerGetConstantName
methods.description: Gets name of a constant by index.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerGetConstantOriginalFQN
methods.description: Gets original FQN of a constant.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerGetConstantFromFolded
methods.description: Checks if a constant is from folded.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerGetConstantType
methods.description: Gets type of a constant.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerGetConstantDtype
methods.description: Gets dtype of a constant.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerGetConstantDataSize
methods.description: Gets data size of a constant.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerExtractConstantsMap
methods.description: Extracts constants map used in container.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerUpdateUserManagedConstantBuffer
methods.description: Updates constant buffer with user-managed ConstantMap.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerUpdateUserManagedConstantBufferPairs
methods.description: Updates constant buffer with pairs of constant entries.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerUpdateConstantBuffer
methods.description: Updates constant buffer with provided ConstantMap.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerUpdateInactiveConstantBuffer
methods.description: Updates inactive constant buffer.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerFreeInactiveConstantBuffer
methods.description: Frees inactive constant buffer.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerRunConstantFolding
methods.description: Runs constant folding on the buffer.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerSwapConstantBuffer
methods.description: Swaps active and inactive constant buffers.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerGetNumInputs
methods.description: Retrieves number of inputs.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerGetInputName
methods.description: Gets input name by index.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerGetNumOutputs
methods.description: Retrieves number of outputs.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerGetOutputName
methods.description: Gets output name by index.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelCreate
methods.description: Creates an inductor model instance.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelRun
methods.description: Runs inference on a model instance.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelUpdateConstantsMap
methods.description: Updates model's constant map.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelGetNumOutputs
methods.description: Gets number of outputs for a model.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerGetCallSpec
methods.description: Retrieves call specifications.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelDelete
methods.description: Deletes a model instance.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelUpdateConstantsFromBlob
methods.description: Loads weights from a blob.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelGetNumOutputs
methods.description: Gets number of outputs for a model.
